name: Ascheberg (Germany)
description: Hanging banner with vertical stripes of yellow, red and yellow in the proportions 1:3:1, charged in the upper half with the municipal arms of Ascheberg (a green ash tree on yellow above red).
history: The flag is gold-red-gold striped lengthwise in the ratio 1:3:1 with the municipal arms in the middle of the upper half of the red stripe.
